items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: Kemperd was kind of a little cousin of mine, you know. Well, they used to call me Freddy Kemperd.

ctx.x: Tell them about what they used to call you. You remember we were talking about how people get your name confused?

Oh, yeah. Well, you see, Kemperd was kind of a little cousin of mine, you know. Well, they used to call me Freddy Kemperd. Oh, really? Yeah. His brother, Louis, lives around on Burry Street now, you see. And they say, well, that's my cousin. You see, well, they called him, called me Freddy Kemperd. Everywhere I went, people used to call me Freddy Kemperd.
Did you look like him some, too?
